## Summary of the last run

The page is largely correct. I checked the remark on implication not being pointwise, the counterexample with the arrow category, the groupoid Boolean problem, the Beck–Chevalley problem, the forall-not-pointwise problem, and the supplement claims. The supplement's statement that $\wedge$ is the right adjoint of the diagonal is actually correct ($\Delta\dashv\wedge$), so I do not report it. The claim that a presheaf topos is Boolean iff the base is a groupoid is a standard true result. The remark about Kripke semantics and the correspondence with interior are accurate. I found no genuine logical, hypothesis, or citation errors worth reporting.
